ov: Small New World monkeys with short, close fur: black at the shoulders, yellow or orange on the back and limbs, and white on the face. They live in the forest canopy in groups of up to 500, and can sweat only through their palms and soles.
rg: Tropical forests of the Amazon, with one species in Costa Rica and Panama.
df: Omnivores: mainly fruit and insects, plus seeds, leaves, flowers, nuts and eggs.
fx: Because they sweat only through their hands and feet, they also cool off by rubbing urine on their skin.
Their calls include warnings about large falcons, a natural predator.
